takes.h: Steve Miner's Jason wraps, dated for August 13, 2027
takes.p: JoBlo, citing Deadline, reports that the new Friday the 13th film is titled Jason and was wrapping production, with a worldwide theatrical release set for August 13, 2027. Schuyler White plays Jason and Natalie Alyn Lind plays Lauren. David Fliegel wrote the script; Cineverse distributes in North America.
